quirks: Charges x402 ($0.003 on Base) BEFORE checking auth, then returns 401 "Service 'openrouter' requires authentication" — you lose the payment.
Requires your own upstream OpenRouter API key passed via X-Upstream-Token header (authType bearer). It is NOT a keyless x402 service despite the 402 paywall.
Violates the no-API-key policy — do not include as usable; calling it without a key wastes USDC.
usage.guide: Do not call this endpoint without an upstream OpenRouter API key. The httpay gateway charges the x402 micropayment first and only then validates auth, so a keyless call pays $0.003 and gets a 401 back. To actually use it you must hold your own OpenRouter bearer key and pass it in the X-Upstream-Token header. For a keyless registry, treat this as broken/unusable.
